note: The LMS President announces that Council has set up an AI Working Group, chaired by Vice-President Iain Gordon, covering research, education, publishing, ethics and the mathematical workforce, including doctoral students and early-career researchers. The Society is working with the Academy for the Mathematical Sciences, the Isaac Newton Institute, ICMS and others, and will announce updated journal policies in the coming weeks.
title: Mathematics and AI: A Message from the LMS President
